plan.failure: Historical first-member deduplication discarded full-validated duplicate endpoints with lower truth-free full residual.
plan.change: Replay identical saved endpoint order. A valid duplicate may replace its nearest representative only if its full residual is lower and its distance to every other representative remains >= the original material threshold .03. Preserve all valid endpoints in an immutable success ledger; reinsertion earns no discovery.
plan.comparison: Historical first-member rule versus quality replacement, identical frozen cached candidate pool and physical cost.
plan.thresholds: Original radial exact volume L2/abs(1.5+.1i) and original 2D RMS/1.2, both .03; no threshold optimization.
plan.scope_limit: Archive replay is not a counterfactual search-policy experiment. Earlier representative replacement would change adaptive proposals; those unobserved proposals are not reconstructed. No new-world discovery credit.

interpretation: Improves retained representative fit within fixed saved pools. Any lost structural coverage is reported explicitly. This does not reproduce counterfactual online adaptive proposals.
